model.description: Bridged to test/visual/r3035-coloring-gate.mjs (DET-3x GREEN on v0.7.51). SCREENSHOT+PIXEL via the .de-gutter-<kind> strip element (locate+sample, NEVER DOM-count). Deterministic synthetic 3-way fixture (override resolveBase) yields ALL 4 kinds: left MODIFY, right DELETE, left ADD, both-diverge CONFLICT (stable:false). Asserts add=GREEN/delete=RED-not-blue(bug fix)/modify=BLUE/conflict=BROWN; acceptChange >> on the DELETION RE-ADDS the deleted line to CENTER. Two-key: computeMergedCenter(kind+palette) + acceptChange(per-kind actions).
